Q01.drivers: Slim, typical proportions; normal waist taper, pelvis and limb lengths

Q02.drivers: Very deep, faceted slab-like trunk that extends well behind the back line in profile; abrupt step where trunk meets thigh at the hip; broad flat chest; columnar legs with weak knee definition. Could be an obese human, but the trunk reads as blocky planes rather than soft fat distribution, and it matches Q12
axial_cues: trunk depth much greater than pelvis
hard step at trunk-to-pelvis junction in profile

Q05.drivers: Average build, slightly broader shoulders, normal proportions

Q07.drivers: Slightly heavier, prominent buttock/belly in profile but within normal range

Q09.drivers: Profile shows a strongly convex, barrel/keel-like upper trunk that bulges forward and back, then pinches sharply at a narrow pelvis; legs thin with knotty knee bulge; long arms with large hands reaching mid-thigh; front shows dark smooth chest band and narrow hips
axial_cues: rounded keel/barrel chest projecting front and back
limb_cues: thin legs with pronounced knee bulge

Q10.drivers: Broad-shouldered, slight belly/buttock depth in profile; still ordinary human proportions

Q11.drivers: Same pattern as Q09: convex barrel upper trunk in profile, sharp pelvic pinch, thin knotty legs, long arms and large hands; trunk segment relations do not match human
axial_cues: barrel/keel chest bulging front and back

Q12.drivers: Extremely wide, rectangular blocky trunk with a flat front plate and hard edges; profile is a deep slab with straight vertical front and back and a hard step at the hip; columnar legs; trunk widens to hips with no waist
limb_cues: arms held out by wide trunk

groups.label: blocky slab-trunk, waistless, stepped hip (heavy race or very obese)
barrel/keel chest with pinched pelvis, thin knotty legs, long arms

distinguishing_features: Q02/Q12 are wide, deep, rectangular and waistless with flat faceted planes and a hard trunk-to-thigh step, columnar limbs. Q09/Q11 are the opposite: a rounded barrel/keel upper trunk bulging front and back, a sharply pinched narrow pelvis, thin legs with prominent knees, and long arms with large hands. Q02 is the least certain; it could be an obese human.
